## Landscape Summary
- 11 systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

## INBOUND MATERIAL RECEIPT & INSPECTION ⭐⭐⭐ NEW
- **my.mes:agent:SupplierQualityComplianceOrchestrator:v1** - ⭐ BEST FIT FOR MATERIAL RECEIPT INSPECTION: Processes incoming material inspections; monitors supplier quality metrics and vendor compliance; orchestrates quality certifications against POs and contracts; escalates non-conformance issues to vendors; maintains manufacturing standards

## SUPPLIER PERFORMANCE & VENDOR ASSESSMENT ⭐
- **sap.s4:agent:ProcurementMatchingAgent:v1** - Analyzes vendor master data, historical performance metrics; evaluates vendor pricing, lead times, quality ratings, contract terms; optimizes procurement decisions

## SUPPLIER QUALIFICATION & MATERIAL COMPLIANCE ⭐
- **sap.ariba:agent:SupplierComplianceAndIncidentMonitor:v1** - Tracks hazardous material certifications; executes regulatory verification; identifies non-compliance; routes safety alerts before procurement

## PAYROLL & EMPLOYEE PAYMENT PROCESSING ⭐
- **workday.hcm:agent:CompensationAdjustmentAutomation:v1** - Processes merit increases and compensation adjustments; integrates with payroll cycles

## COMPENSATION POLICY & PAYROLL REGULATIONS
- **sap.sf:agent:CompensationPolicyAutomationEngine:v1** - Enforces compensation policies and payroll regulations
- **workday.hcm:agent:CompensationChangeProcessor:v1** - Validates compensation modifications against payroll processing timelines

## PRODUCT COMPLIANCE & BOM VALIDATION ⭐
- **siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1** - Validates BOM against regulatory & engineering standards

## EQUIPMENT MODIFICATION & SERVICE VALIDATION ⭐
- **siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndComplianceOrchestrator:v1** - Equipment validation for production readiness

## SAFETY COMPLIANCE FOR ENGINEERING CHANGES ⭐
- **sap.ehs:agent:SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator:v1** - Automates safety validation across engineering changes

## INCIDENT ANALYSIS & ROOT CAUSE (EHS)
- **sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1** - Analyzes SafetyIncidents to identify root causes
- **sap.ehs:agent:IncidentResponseCoordinator:v1** - Coordinates safety incident workflows

## PROCUREMENT - PURCHASE ORDER MANAGEMENT ⭐
- **sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1** - REST API for creating, updating, monitoring POs

## PROCUREMENT - SOURCING CAMPAIGN & ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT ⭐
- **sap.ariba:apiResource:SourceingCampaignAndAccountManagementAPI:v1** - Retrieves sourcing campaigns, customer accounts, vendor relationships

## PROCUREMENT - WORKFORCE COST CORRELATION ⭐
- **sap.ariba:apiResource:ProcurementWorkforceCompensationAPI:v1** - Employee compensation with procurement workflows

## PROCUREMENT & MATERIAL IMPACT FOR PRODUCT TRANSITIONS
- **sap.ariba:agent:MaterialAndEngineeringChangeCoordinator:v1** - Coordinates material updates and engineering changes

## SALES OPPORTUNITY QUALIFICATION & PRIORITIZATION ⭐
- **sap.crm:agent:OpportunityQualificationAdvisor:v1** - Evaluates sales opportunities against qualification criteria

## PRODUCT TRANSITION & SALES COORDINATION
- **sap.crm:agent:SalesProductChangeCoordinator:v1** - Monitors engineering changes; automates notification
- **emarsys.cx:agent:ProductLifecycleOrchestrator:v1** - Monitors engineering changes; triggers customer engagement

## ANALYTICS & REPORTING FOR SERVICE TO PRODUCTION
- **corp.itsm:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1** - Generates diagnostic reports, analyzes incident patterns

## SALES COMPENSATION & PERFORMANCE
- **sap.crm:agent:SalesCompensationOrchestrator:v1** - Sales-specific compensation

## SERVICE REQUEST & ORDER CAPTURE
- **sap.s4:agent:OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine** - Converts sales opportunities to customer orders

## PRODUCTION QUALITY & YIELD ANALYSIS ⭐
- **my.mes:apiResource:EquipmentOEEAnalytics:v1** - OEE data for production quality & yield
- **my.mes:agent:ProductionQualityMonitor:v1** - Real-time quality monitoring

## WORKFORCE COMPENSATION & LABOR ALLOCATION ⭐
- **sap.sf:agent:SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1** - Workforce capability alignment
